payload.text: cc's 0352-1 (release target, tip 00b67963) shares lib/helpers with 0354-1 and 0355-1 and reworks gates_verb, so under hv's speed ruling that ready units run as one stack it rebases onto 0354-1 and the two run as one stack, one driver, each unit's red arms at its own base, then the union of legs once and test scans once; cc re-asks the Desk with --place-of 01M7MHWYTNTHK4GCSQ8Z4NTSJM, and dc bases 0355-1 on the stack's landing.
